verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents several set-based operations that act on many rows at once. These are predicate-based deletes (table.delete with a SQL filter), adding a computed column across all rows via SQL expressions, and multi-vector search in a single call. The evidence is mostly code snippets, though, and coverage of other bulk operations is not shown. missing for 10: documented bulk update/upsert and bulk insert, prose docs describing batch semantics and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Search multiple query vectors in one call.
You can manually trigger an incremental indexing operation on updated data using the `optimize()` method on a table.
